description: Shared test vectors for LocalDictationCore (Swift, Sources/LocalDictationCore.swift) and lf-dictation (Rust). Every vector is synthetic. origin=swift: ported from Tests/LocalDictationTests.swift, verified on macOS. origin=rust-edge: additional edge cases whose expected values follow documented Swift and ICU semantics; they are verified in Rust only until the Swift tests consume this file. A process vector checks only the expected fields it lists. Options default to true; macros default to none.

process.input: quote ship it end quote press enter
All lowercase Make Check, press enter.

spoken_delimiters_comment: process(input) with default options must output `expected`; with spoken delimiters disabled it must output `expected_disabled`, which defaults to `input`.
